content: this is a summary of a civil case heard in the klaipeda district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the applicant was awarded a plot of land and a vehicle while the defendant was awarded an apartment the court also stated that the rights and obligations of a real estate lease agreement would remain with the applicant after the dissolution of the marriage the court referred to various articles from the civil code related to property division in a marriage the applicant requested the court to dissolve the marriage retain their surname and order the defendant to pay nonpecuniary damages the applicant also wanted the court to declare the defendants apartment household goods and personal property as part of the dissolution of the marriage the applicant claimed that the breakdown of the marriage was due to the defendants alcohol addiction and infidelity the defendant has the opportunity to file a statement of defense the court will decide on the division of the matrimonial property including the apartment land plot and car as well as consider the rights and obligations of a real estate lease agreement the court will also determine the costs of the action including stamp duty and legal aid costs in the end the court awarded the applicant the plot of land and a vehicle and the defendant was awarded the apartment the court also stated that the rights and obligations of a real estate lease agreement would remain with the applicant the remaining parts of the application were dismissed and the defendant was ordered to pay the costs of the proceedings and stamp duty

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.123 Deviation from equal shares of the spouses' community property
Art. 3.117 Shares in the matrimonial property
Art. 3.87 The essence of the statutory matrimonial property regime
